## Community consensus

::: {.mxcw-curation-invitation}
This atlas is a living flora of the W̱SÁNEĆ/Saanich Peninsula, and its records are only as good as what we know of
them. If you know whether a plant is still to be found here, whether it was planted, or whether it has failed to
establish, please add your note.

<span class="saanich-callout">Click on any taxon in the checklist below</span> to choose it for curation. You can
also choose a taxon from any other part of the atlas, through the speech bubble beside its name.
:::

<div class="mxcw-curation-form-holder" @id="curationForm"></div>
